design.name: inverse-bid-ensemble-v1
design.scope: Full-year in-sample inverse bid calibration, not recovered actual bids, untouched validation, posterior inference or a forecast confidence interval

price_proposal.features: Constant, annual sine/cosine, first local-clock daily sine/cosine; existing hashed calendar columns0,1,2,3,4, including DST
price_proposal.interpretation: Fit observed-minus-parent-cleared price only where at least one local resource offer is interior and matches the saved dual. This is a proposal heuristic, not a unique causal marginal-generator label. Unsupported groups get zero coefficients.

mix_proposal.coverage: Require all12 Ember national months; compare annual sum of conditional allocation bounds with annual reference, not an hourly generation-derived availability
mix_proposal.rule: -15 times signed reference outside annual interval /max(reference,1), clipped +/-15, distributed to columns by original source-nameplate country shares

design.bid_rule: Accepted annual refit bid + clipped accumulated smooth price/mix adjustment + nonnegative monotone gas/coal block premium; final floor0. Nuclear has no peaking block. Other bids and every physical input unchanged.
design.regularization: Availability-weighted mean square bid departure from accepted bids, normalized by maximum family departure105/85/15 EUR/MWh
design.selection: At each round choose the eligible minimum regularized objective among all completed states, baseline included. Ties prefer lower penalty then earlier ordinal. Exactly two rounds; identical bid hashes reuse an existing witness.

ensemble.selection: Among eligible distinct bid states within both best-score+0.01 and best-MAE+1, retain best first, then greedily maximize minimum normalized RMS parameter distance to retained states; ties prefer lower score then earlier ordinal
ensemble.interpretation: Equal-weight descriptive finite fit ensemble; no probability weights, posterior or calibrated uncertainty claim. Report observed-hour coverage of min/max envelope even if poor. Mean prices are a descriptive average, not a single cleared network. No investment run in this experiment.

design.fixed: Accepted capacity/availability, demand, fixed hydro, source chronology, PTDF/GSK/grid/link/island constraints, monthly fuel anchors and inherited calendar coefficients; no source sensitivity adopted
design.gates: All41 eligible observed-price zones and all48 modeled areas, negative/extreme hours, independent source/native-physics/primal-dual/monthly quantity/search-selection replay. Research filters are experimental screens, not new product acceptance criteria. No automatic baseline or browser promotion.

publication_scope: Hourly error diagnosis and two controlled weekly supply-bid corrections; prior inverse/network/source studies remain supporting evidence.
legacy_limitations: Country Ember and zonal A75 sources are separate. Germany generation excludes LU; France uses national model membership including FR-COR.
Missing types/hours remain unknown; per-area error covers reported fuels only. Not certified total-fleet generation or exact commercial geography.
Point allocations proportional to original availability within saved equal-price blocks; conditional bounds not jointly attainable or all primal optima. No new solve, input change or promotion.
limitations: Effective AC headroom/wind derating are experimental bounds, not verified physical corrections.
National five-fuel and implied-export checks are not certified zonal generation or physical border-flow validation.
No recovered true grid/bids, posterior, investment acceptance or browser integration.

design.name: joint-network-calibration-v1
design.scope: Full-year in-sample finite calibration of supply bids, wind availability and effective AC ratings; not a recovered physical grid or actual bids
design.network_rule: Multiply the existing static symmetric AC branch MW limits, globally or on branches with either endpoint in NO/SE/FI/DK. Existing 0.7 rating multiplier becomes 0.595 or 0.805. Preserve susceptance/PTDF, topology, static nameplate GSK, offsets, islands, HVDC bounds and losses. These are experimental effective headroom bounds, not observed JAO domains, N-1 proof or physical expansion.
design.wind_rule: Multiply original source wind available MW by the declared scalar before aggregating existing offer groups; preserve hourly weather shape, source nominal MW and country membership. Update quantity-allocation availability consistently. This is a bounded profile/derating calibration hypothesis, not an IRENA capacity correction, measured outage or dispatch substituted for availability. No target-derived hourly profile.
design.fixed: Demand, hydro/water chronology, nuclear/solar/other availability, nameplates, grouping, topology, susceptance, original GSK, links, islands, offsets, monthly fuel anchors and each chosen bid anchor are unchanged. No new bid fit, arbitrary per-hour constraint fit or retired hydro/search restart.
design.regularization: Old availability-weighted bid penalty against accepted bids plus mean square of [wind deviation/0.1, mean AC deviation/0.15] over three coordinates: wind, Nordic-incident AC, remaining AC. Coordinate departures are counted even if a region is small. All deviation directions are relative to accepted source inputs.
design.selection: Lowest eligible regularized score over exactly the declared finite states, ties lower penalty then ordinal. Retain every failed or adverse state. Reuse the two hash-verified unchanged-physics annual witnesses. No adaptive range expansion or automatic baseline promotion.
design.observations: All41 complete A44 observed-price zones, all48 modeled areas, Ember monthly national five-fuel generation and signed net exports with original missingness. Implied export is not physical border flow; no verified hourly JAO/ENTSO-E border-flow fit in this trial.
design.acceptance: Independent modified-source allocation, component-native physics, primal/dual, quantity, metric and selection replay. Research filters are not product acceptance gates; no forecast, posterior, true capacity, investment-value or browser integration claim.
design.rejection_policy: Amended after the first tightened-AC control reported Infeasible: reject a full-year candidate at its first numerically certified infeasible hour, saving a Farkas row ray for independent replay; no annual metric for rejected/partial cases. Uncertified failures remain unresolved. Every selectable case still needs all8760 optimal hours and original no-emergency/quantity gates. Finite parameter grid/objective unchanged. Reuse the complete first wind control with interrupted-producer provenance rather than rerunning it.

design.predictor: Local Saturday/Sunday indicator minus its full-2025 mean, with DST; no holiday inference, residual demand or hour-specific target lookup
design.fit: All-year in-sample observed-minus-anchor prices, only matching local interior gas/coal/nuclear offers (>0.001 MW from both bounds, price difference <=0.00001). Regress against existing 15 calendar nuisance columns plus centered weekend; retain only weekend coefficient. Clip response +/-100 EUR/MWh; ridge 168 I; at least 168 matching hours and 24 of each day type.
design.offers: Same family/zone adjustment on every block; floor final offers at zero. All other offers and all physical inputs unchanged relative to each anchor.
design.research_filters: Each correction must reduce its anchor full-year price MAE, with daily-demeaned, generation and trade errors no more than 2% worse; 8760 optimal hours, zero emergency <=1e-6 MWh, independent source/native/dual replay. These are experimental safeguards, not acceptance or automatic promotion.
design.scope: One predetermined correction per anchor, no strength sweep/refit after results. 2025 reconstruction, not independent forecast validation or identified real bids. Previous joint calibration stays a checkpoint. No baseline/browser promotion.
